in_hebrew.name: Yancey
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Yancey הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Greek name 'Iesous', meaning 'God saves'. Derived from 'Yah', the Hebrew name for God, and 'Sauos', meaning 'healer'. In Christian tradition, Yancey can represent a devotion to Jesus as the healer.
